bind_pose: identity (mesh authored in bind pose; zero-rotation FK reproduces the OBJ exactly)

skeleton.axis_convention: torso/neck/head flex + = bend forward, abd + = bend left, twist + = turn right; clavicle flex + = shoulder forward, abd + = shrug up; arm flex + = swing forward, abd + = outboard, twist + = segment roll; leg flex + = hip forward / knee folds back, abd + = outboard; foot flex + = dorsiflexion

humanoid.helper_note: helper bones stay in the hierarchy but map to no humanoid slot; the forearm is split in two so wrist roll is distributed and the toe rides the ball
humanoid.pose_note: bind pose is a relaxed A-pose: the arm hangs 22 deg off vertical, elbows gently bent (18.7 deg), legs straight; Unity's AvatarBuilder solves the T-pose from it

weights: computed deterministically from the bind position by Tools/body_rig.py:weights_for(side, chain, point); the hands delegate to Tools/hand_rig.py, the boots to Tools/boot_rig.py
detail_binding: parts with `bind: stiff` are small solids (stitch dashes, buttons, buckles, rivets, rings, patches, straps, ears, eyes) up to Tools/body_rig.py:DETAIL_MAX_DIAGONAL across: all their vertices share the weights of the part `centroid`, so they keep their shape instead of folding through themselves or shearing across a joint
